content.heading: Arrest and detention
content.text: A judgment-debtor may be arrested in execution of a decree at any hour and on any day, and shall, as soon as practicable, be brought before the Court. No dwelling-house shall be entered after sunset and before sunrise. No outer door shall be broken open unless the dwelling is in the occupancy of the judgment-debtor and he refuses or prevents access. Where the decree is for money and the judgment-debtor pays the amount or the process fee, he shall be released. Women have additional enacted protections read with Section 56.
